data.name: Moutir
data.gender_notes: Moutir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root ‘m-w-t’, meaning to search or seek. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and truth in life. The name Moutir carries the meaning “Seeker of truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Moutir usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual journey of seeking knowledge and truth.
data.etymology: Moutir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeker of truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moutir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: موتير
in_arabic.meaning: موتير يعني من يرزق الناس بالموت
in_arabic.long_meaning: موتير هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'مات' يموت، ويعني من يرزق الناس بالموت أو من يقدر الأعمار للخلق. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة آيات تتحدث عن قدرة الله تعالى على الموت والحياة.

in_urdu.name: موتیर
in_urdu.meaning: موتیر کا مطلب ہے موت دینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: موتیر ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل 'مات' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے موت دینے والا یا موت کا باعث بننے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی قدرت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے موت اور زندگی پر

in_hindi.name: मौतिर
in_hindi.meaning: मौतिर का अर्थ है मृत्यु प्रदान करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौतिर एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'मात' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मृत्यु प्रदान करने वाला। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि यह ईश्वर की शक्ति को दर्शाता है मृत्यु और जीवन पर

in_pashto.name: موتير
in_pashto.meaning: موتير د مرګ ورکوونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: موتير د يوه نوم دى چه د عربي ژبې د کلمې 'مات' څخه اخستل شوى دى، چه د مرګ ورکوونکی يا د مړينې سبب دى. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په منځ کې مهم ګڼل کيږي ځکه چه دا د الله تعالی قدرت ښيي په مرګ او ژوند باندى

in_english.name: Moutir
in_english.meaning: Moutir means the one who gives death
in_english.long_meaning: Moutir is derived from the Arabic verb 'māta', meaning to die. The name signifies the one who gives death or determines the lifespan of creatures. In Islamic tradition, it reflects Allah's power over life and death, mentioned in several Quranic verses.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta, Travels in Asia and Africa, p. 416, mentions a fortress near the town of Mautir in Tangier, Morocco, which was a major stronghold of the Marinid Empire (1212-1465 AD).
